segs.text: How to increase your rizq in thirty seconds.
Step one. Fear Allah when nobody is watching.
Allah says: And whoever is mindful of Allah, He will make a way out for them, and provide for them from sources they could never imagine.

quote.text: And whoever is mindful of Allah, He will make a way out for them, and provide for them from sources they could never imagine.

segs.text: Step two. Trust Him more than your bank balance.
And whoever puts their trust in Allah, then He alone is sufficient for them.

quote.text: And whoever puts their trust in Allah, then He (alone) is sufficient for them.

segs.text: The Prophet, peace be upon him, said: Whoever loves that he be granted more wealth and that his lease of life be prolonged, then he should keep good relations with his kith and kin.

quote.text: Whoever loves that he be granted more wealth and that his lease of life be prolonged, then he should keep good relations with his Kith and kin.

segs.text: Send this to someone who is worried about money.
